from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687674/attempts/fe7b32dd748346a8b1b7c0aebff056b5/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Each diagonal pair defines a ray. Extend from either exposed endpoint;
    # an existing non-background cell blocks that direction.
    dirs = [(1, 1), (1, -1)]
    pairs = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 9:
                continue
            for dr, dc in dirs:
                rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
                if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    pairs.add((color, r, c, rr, cc, dr, dc))
    for color, r1, c1, r2, c2, dr, dc in pairs:
        for r, c, vr, vc in ((r1, c1, -dr, -dc), (r2, c2, dr, dc)):
            rr, cc = r + vr, c + vc
            if not (0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w) or grid[rr][cc] != 9:
                continue
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == 9:
                out[rr][cc] = color
                rr += vr
                cc += vc
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-d0e5bcd9.py'
path.write_text(program)
